title: Spraay Batch Worker Plugin
description: Configures the worker that builds unsigned batch transactions through the Spraay gateway.

chains.description: Chains enabled for batches. The gateway's estimate.supported must also be true.

max_recipients.description: Largest number of recipients allowed in one batch.

redact_recipients.description: Remove recipient addresses, the sender, and calldata from emitted events.

priority.description: Middleware priority. Lower values run earlier.

max_access_fee_raw.description: Largest x402 access fee, in raw base units, offered to the app's payment callback.

gateway_url.description: Gateway base URL. Falls back to SPRAAY_GATEWAY_URL, then https://gateway.spraay.app.
